_comment: Withdrawal adviser settings. Recommendations only - the adviser can never sell, transfer or withdraw. Every opt-in rule is OFF by default, so the default recommendation is GBP 0 unless you configure a reason to take money out.

scenarios._source: Assumptions, not forecasts. Base sits below the research's measured long-run nominal equity CAGRs (world equity in GBP: 8.1%/yr 1992-2010, 11.1%/yr 2011-2026; US market 1927-2026 about 10%/yr in USD). Adverse is a lost decade (US 2000-2009 was about -1%/yr). The shock row is a 40% fall, comparable to 2008-09 in GBP terms.

gia_tax._comment: UK Capital Gains Tax applies to gains realised by selling in a General Investment Account. Check HMRC for the current annual exempt amount; the value below is only used to flag when realised gains approach it.

isa._comment: Only used when account_type is ISA. Whether withdrawn ISA money can be replaced without using allowance depends on the provider offering a flexible ISA; set to true/false once confirmed with Trading 212.
